title: Agent provenance metadata for issues and comments
description:
Add optional, validated `agent` metadata so AI coding agents can record which platform, model, and settings were used when creating an issue or posting a comment. Metadata is optional, stored in issue JSON, displayed in CLI and console only when present, and recorded in event payloads for auditability.

## Problem

When humans and multiple AI agents collaborate in Kanbus, `author: agent` and `KANBUS_USER=agent` do not distinguish Cursor from Claude Code, Codex, or Antigravity, nor which model or settings produced a change. Provenance matters for debugging, policy enforcement, and multi-agent coordination.

## Design decisions (resolved)

| Decision | Choice | Rationale |
|----------|--------|-----------|
| Storage location | Top-level optional `agent` on `IssueData` and `IssueComment` | Typed, validated, avoids `custom` collisions and overlay keys |
| Not in | `custom.agent`, `comment.data.agent`, `agent_metadata` | One way only; `comment.data` reserved for summary compaction |
| Issue semantics | Set at create only; immutable thereafter | Avoids conflating filing agent with human triage edits |
| Comment semantics | Optional per comment | Matches mandatory running-log workflow in comments |
| Platform | Validated string (max 64, lowercase `[a-z0-9_-]+`) | Document canonical values; avoid enum lock-in when new tools appear |
| Canonical platforms | `claude_code`, `codex`, `antigravity`, `cursor` | CLI autocomplete and docs; unknown-but-valid strings accepted |
| Settings | Allowlisted keys only | `temperature` (0.0-2.0), `thinking_level` (off/low/medium/high), `max_output_tokens` (>0) |
| Secrets | Reject keys matching api_key/token/secret/password/credential | Prevent accidental git commits of credentials |
| Size limit | Max 2 KB serialized `agent` block | Limit repo bloat on chatty agent sessions |
| Env defaults | `KANBUS_AGENT_PLATFORM`, `KANBUS_AGENT_MODEL`, `KANBUS_AGENT_SETTINGS` | Mirrors `KANBUS_USER`; flags override env |
| CLI flags | `--agent-platform`, `--agent-model`, `--agent-settings` | On `create` and `comment` only (not `update`) |
| Beads mode | Reject `--agent-*` with clear error | Beads JSONL cannot round-trip comment metadata |
| Display | CLI `format_issue_for_display` + console `AgentMetadataBlock` | Only when `agent` present; no empty placeholders |

## Data model

```json
{
  "agent": {
    "platform": "cursor",
    "model": "composer-2.5",
    "settings": {
      "temperature": 0.2,
      "thinking_level": "high"
    }
  }
}
```

Omit the `agent` key entirely when absent (not `null`). Omit `settings` when empty.

## Architecture

```mermaid
flowchart TB
  subgraph input [Agent runtime]
    CLI[CLI flags]
    ENV[KANBUS_AGENT_* env]
  end

  subgraph validate [Write boundary]
    RESOLVE[resolve_agent_metadata]
    VALID[Validate platform model settings]
  end

  subgraph persist [Native Kanbus storage]
    ISSUE[IssueData.agent create-only]
    COMMENT[IssueComment.agent per comment]
    EVENTS[Event payloads snapshot]
  end

  subgraph display [Conditional display]
    CLIOUT[CLI show / create output]
    CONSOLE[Console detail + comments]
  end

  CLI --> RESOLVE
  ENV --> RESOLVE
  RESOLVE --> VALID
  VALID --> ISSUE
  VALID --> COMMENT
  ISSUE --> EVENTS
  COMMENT --> EVENTS
  ISSUE --> CLIOUT
  COMMENT --> CLIOUT
  ISSUE --> CONSOLE
  COMMENT --> CONSOLE
```

## Definition of done

- Gherkin specs pass in Python and Rust
- Python/Rust parity on validation, storage, CLI flags, display, and error messages
- Console shows agent metadata only when present (issue header + per comment)
- Event payloads include `agent` on `issue_created` and `comment_added` when present
- Beads mode rejects agent flags with a clear error
- Documentation updated in CLI reference and CONTRIBUTING_AGENT.md

## Out of scope (follow-up epics)

- `agent.session_id` deduplication across comments
- `kbs list --agent-platform` filtering
- Beads upstream schema proposal
- `--json` on create/comment commands

comments.text:
## Implementation order

1. **kbs-fd7bef** (spec) then **kbs-991064** + **kbs-086571** — models, validation, issue create
2. **kbs-371786** (spec) then **kbs-dbf8b6** + **kbs-6b4ff6** + **kbs-694bc0** — comment path, CLI display, Gherkin
3. **kbs-1d5214** (spec) then **kbs-c10bf1** + **kbs-2ab1f8** — events and Beads guard
4. **kbs-dd1f4a** (spec) then **kbs-6d42b9** + **kbs-6435f0** — console UI (can parallelize with CLI after models land)
5. **kbs-17b4a4** — documentation last

## Adversarial review resolutions

- Top-level `agent` field (not custom, not comment.data)
- Platform as validated string (canonical list documented, not closed enum in storage)
- Settings allowlist only (temperature, thinking_level, max_output_tokens)
- Issue agent immutable after create; no agent on update
- Beads mode rejects agent flags (no silent loss)
- Event payloads must snapshot agent for audit trail

## Open product question (deferred)

Comment-only v1 would halve surface area if filing provenance is low priority. Current plan ships both create-only issue agent and per-comment agent.
